minexray.title: MineXray
minemeboost.text.minexray.tooltip: X-ray and ESP for singleplayer: Classic X-Ray, Ore ESP, caves, lava, chests, mobs, scanner.
minexray.mode.classic.desc: Hides stone, dirt and the like: only the preset's Visible blocks stay drawn. Full brightness while on.
minexray.mode.ore_esp.desc: Outlines the preset's blocks through walls, touching ones as one vein, with labels and tracers. Doesn't rebuild chunks.
minexray.mode.cave_finder.desc: Shows caves and ravines (cave air) below a height you choose, as dots or an outline.
minexray.mode.fluid_view.desc: Lava in orange and (optionally) water in blue, through walls.
minexray.mode.block_esp.desc: Chests, spawners, vaults, portals, budding amethyst, suspicious sand, sculk, infested blocks... each category with its own switch and colour.
minexray.mode.entity_esp.desc: Boxes around mobs through walls: hostile red, passive green, players blue, items yellow. Replaces Mob Glow.
minexray.mode.lava_warning.desc: Warns you (and beeps) when there's lava up to 3 blocks behind or under the block you're mining. Works with the other modes off.
minexray.overview.preset.tooltip: Click for the next one (%s presets). Edit them on the Presets and Blocks pages.
minexray.overview.help: Several modes can be on at once. Classic X on X, Ore ESP on G; the rest in Settings > Keys.
minexray.overview.adaptive: Adaptive range: %s%% of the radius (FPS below target)
minexray.classic.sodium: Classic X-Ray isn't available with Sodium, use Ore ESP
minexray.label: %s ×%d · %dm
minexray.blocks.add_looked.tooltip: Adds the block under your crosshair (there's also a key for it).
minexray.blocks.visible.tooltip: V: stays drawn in Classic X-Ray
minexray.blocks.esp.tooltip: E: highlighted by Ore ESP / Block ESP
minexray.blocks.category.tooltip: Category: Ores and Other belong to Ore ESP, the rest to Block ESP
minexray.blocks.empty: Nothing here. Switch to All blocks, or search.
minexray.blocks.hold_block: Hold a block in your hand first
minexray.presets.use.tooltip: Also switches on the modes and categories this preset asks for.
minexray.presets.name: Name
minexray.presets.export.tooltip: Copies a text code of this preset to the clipboard, to share.
minexray.presets.import.tooltip: Adds the preset whose code is in the clipboard.
minexray.presets.import_failed: The clipboard doesn't hold a preset code
minexray.presets.auto_dimension.tooltip: Switches preset by itself when you change dimension.
minexray.entry.open.desc: X-ray and ESP modes, block list, presets and scanner.
minexray.entry.mine_nearest.desc: Mines the whole nearest highlighted vein (Vein Miner).
minexray.render.block_limit.tooltip: The nearest blocks are shown first.
minexray.render.tracers.tooltip: Lines from your view to the nearest veins.
minexray.scanner.progress: Scanning in the background... %s sections, %s queued
minexray.scanner.none: No veins found. Press Scan now (it looks for the active preset's blocks).
minexray.scanner.columns: Block ×size · x y z · distance direction
minexray.scanner.teleport.tooltip: Teleport to safe air next to it (singleplayer)
minexray.scanner.mine.tooltip: Mine the whole vein (Vein Miner); drops go to you
minexray.scanner.no_safe_spot: No safe spot next to that vein
minexray.settings.adaptive.tooltip: Shrinks radii and tracers (down to half) while FPS are below your FPS Target.
minexray.settings.adaptive.info: Adaptive range uses MineBoost's FPS Target (30 FPS if it's off).
minexray.settings.cost_test.tooltip: About 2 minutes: each mode off and on, with MineBoost's A/B test. Results in config/minemeboost/xray-cost-results.md.
minexray.settings.safe_mode: Safe Mode: if a mode hits an error, only that mode turns off.
minexray.whats_new.title: §bMineMeBoostXray 3.6.0
minexray.whats_new.xray: §bNew tab, MineXray: §fClassic X-Ray (X), Ore ESP with whole veins, labels and tracers (G), Cave Finder, Fluid View and Lava Warning. Singleplayer only.
minexray.whats_new.esp: §eBlock ESP and Entity ESP: §fchests, spawners, vaults, portals, sculk... each with a colour; mobs by type.
minexray.whats_new.tools: §aTools: §fa block editor for every block (modded too), 9 presets that switch per dimension, a vein scanner (waypoint, show, teleport, mine), and a HUD.
minexray.whats_new.moved: §7Ore Vision, Chest ESP and Mob Glow in MineMenu now switch the MineXray modes; your keys and settings came along.
minexray.render.entity_only: Only these mobs (ids, commas; empty = all)
minexray.safe_mode.disabled: %s was disabled because of an error
minexray.safe_mode.caught: MineXray: an error in %s was caught
minexray.scanner.waypoint.needs_minemenu: Waypoints come from MineMenu (part of MineMeBoostXray).
